title: Search the words of Isaiah
summary: Jesus teaches the people to search the words of Isaiah and the prophets, heed his words, and write what he has taught. He says those who hearken, repent, and are baptized shall be saved.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus commands them to search diligently, saying, “great are the words of Isaiah.”
Jesus says Isaiah spoke concerning the house of Israel and must also speak to the Gentiles; what Isaiah spoke has been and shall be according to his words.
Jesus commands them to heed his words and write what he has told them; those words will go forth to the Gentiles according to the Father's time and will.
Jesus teaches that whoever hearkens to his words, repents, and is baptized shall be saved, and directs them to search the prophets.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus is teaching a gathered audience.
unspecified_visual_details: The audience's size, appearance, and precise arrangement are not stated.
The setting and any writing materials are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: And now, behold, I say unto you, that ye ought to search these things.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: Yea, a commandment I give unto you that ye search these things diligently; for great are the words of Isaiah.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: Therefore give heed to my words; write the things which I have told you;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

spoken_dialogue.text: And whosoever will hearken unto my words and repenteth and is baptized, the same shall be saved.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The teachings about Isaiah and the Gentiles are speech, not a separate depicted event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Isaiah, the Gentiles, or the future fulfillment as present visual events.

title: The record brought before Jesus
summary: After expounding the scriptures they had received, Jesus tells those present that he would have them write other scriptures. He tells Nephi to bring forth the record he has kept. Nephi brings the records and lays them before Jesus, who looks at them.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus had expounded the scriptures they had received before speaking again.
Jesus says he would have them write other scriptures.
Jesus tells Nephi to bring forth the record he has kept.
Nephi brings forth the records and lays them before Jesus, who looks at them.

title: The question about Samuel's prophecy
summary: The Lord says he commanded Samuel the Lamanite to testify about saints who would arise from the dead, appear to many, and minister to them. He asks whether it happened. His disciples answer that Samuel prophesied according to his words and that they were fulfilled.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord says he commanded Samuel the Lamanite to testify to this people about many saints who would arise from the dead, appear to many, and minister to them.
The prophecy concerns the day when the Father would glorify his name in the speaker.
The Lord asks whether it was so; his disciples answer that Samuel prophesied according to his words and that they were all fulfilled.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The Lord speaks to his disciples, who answer him.
unspecified_visual_details: The location and appearances of those present are not specified.
Samuel and the saints are mentioned in speech, not described as present.

title: The omitted record
summary: Jesus asks why the disciples did not write that many saints arose, appeared, and ministered to many. Nephi remembers the omission. Jesus commands that it be written, and it is written as he commanded.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus asks why the disciples did not write that many saints arose, appeared to many, and ministered to them.
Nephi remembers that the event had not been written.
Jesus commands that it be written, and it is written as he commanded.
